info.name: Internship Admin API - Read-only smoke tests
info.description: Safe GET-only checks for the API. These requests do not create, update, or delete database records.

exec: pm.test('Response is a JSON array', () => pm.expect(body).to.be.an('array'));
pm.test('Each user has the documented public fields', () => body.forEach(user => { pm.expect(user).to.have.all.keys('id', 'name', 'email', 'role', 'status', 'createdAt'); }));
pm.test('Password hash is never exposed', () => body.forEach(user => pm.expect(user).not.to.have.property('passwordHash')));
pm.test('Response is a JSON array', () => pm.expect(body).to.be.an('array'));
pm.test('Returned records match the name filter', () => body.forEach(user => pm.expect(user.name.toLowerCase()).to.include(String(pm.environment.get('searchName') || '').toLowerCase())));
pm.test('Password hash is never exposed', () => body.forEach(user => pm.expect(user).not.to.have.property('passwordHash')));
pm.test('Response is a JSON array', () => pm.expect(body).to.be.an('array'));
pm.test('Every returned role is one of the requested roles', () => body.forEach(user => pm.expect(['Member', 'Admin']).to.include(user.role)));
pm.test('Password hash is never exposed', () => body.forEach(user => pm.expect(user).not.to.have.property('passwordHash')));
pm.test('Response has pagination fields', () => { pm.expect(body).to.have.keys('items', 'total', 'page', 'pageSize'); pm.expect(body.items).to.be.an('array'); });
pm.test('Default pagination is page 1 with 20 items', () => { pm.expect(body.page).to.eql(1); pm.expect(body.pageSize).to.eql(20); });

pm.test('Company items have expected fields', () => body.items.forEach(company => pm.expect(company).to.have.all.keys('companyCode', 'companyName', 'level', 'country', 'city', 'foundedYear', 'annualRevenue', 'employees', 'parentCompany')));
pm.test('Total is not smaller than this page', () => pm.expect(body.total).to.be.at.least(body.items.length));
pm.test('Response has pagination fields', () => { pm.expect(body.items).to.be.an('array'); pm.expect(body.total).to.be.a('number'); });
pm.test('Every returned company has level 1', () => body.items.forEach(company => pm.expect(company.level).to.eql(1)));

item.name: GET /companies - multiple levels and page-size cap

exec: pm.test('Page metadata is returned', () => { pm.expect(body.page).to.eql(1); pm.expect(body.pageSize).to.eql(100); });
pm.test('Only requested levels are returned', () => body.items.forEach(company => pm.expect([1, 2]).to.include(company.level)));

pm.test('Items are ordered by level then company code', () => { const sorted = [...body.items].sort((a, b) => a.level - b.level || a.companyCode.localeCompare(b.companyCode)); pm.expect(body.items).to.eql(sorted); });
pm.test('All four summary metrics are present', () => pm.expect(body).to.have.all.keys('companyCount', 'totalRevenue', 'countryCount', 'employeeCount'));
pm.test('Metrics are non-negative numbers', () => Object.values(body).forEach(value => { pm.expect(value).to.be.a('number'); pm.expect(value).to.be.at.least(0); }));
pm.test('Country count cannot exceed company count', () => pm.expect(body.countryCount).to.be.at.most(body.companyCount));
pm.test('Total and levels array are present', () => { pm.expect(body.totalCompanies).to.be.a('number'); pm.expect(body.levels).to.be.an('array'); });

pm.test('Level entries have count and percentage', () => body.levels.forEach(item => { pm.expect(item.level).to.be.a('number'); pm.expect(item.companyCount).to.be.a('number'); pm.expect(item.percentage).to.be.a('number'); }));
pm.test('Level counts add up to the total', () => pm.expect(body.levels.reduce((sum, item) => sum + item.companyCount, 0)).to.eql(body.totalCompanies));

pm.test('Percentages add up to approximately 100 when data exists', () => { if (body.totalCompanies > 0) pm.expect(body.levels.reduce((sum, item) => sum + item.percentage, 0)).to.be.within(99.9, 100.1); });

pm.test('Each point has year, new count, and cumulative count', () => body.years.forEach(point => { pm.expect(point.year).to.be.a('number'); pm.expect(point.newCompanies).to.be.a('number'); pm.expect(point.cumulativeCompanies).to.be.a('number'); }));
pm.test('Years are ascending', () => body.years.forEach((point, index) => { if (index > 0) pm.expect(point.year).to.be.above(body.years[index - 1].year); }));

pm.test('Cumulative counts never decrease', () => body.years.forEach((point, index) => { if (index > 0) pm.expect(point.cumulativeCompanies).to.be.at.least(body.years[index - 1].cumulativeCompanies); }));
